## Which download do I need?

| Your device                                   | Download                                                                                                           |
| --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Windows (most players)                        | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-Windows-x64-Setup.exe`: installs for your user account, no admin rights needed            |
| Windows (every user on the PC, or IT-managed) | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-Windows-x64-AllUsers.msi`: installs for all users under Program Files, needs admin rights |
| Mac with an Apple chip (M1 or later)          | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-macOS-AppleSilicon-arm64.dmg`                                                             |
| Mac with an Intel processor                   | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-macOS-Intel-x64.dmg`                                                                      |
| Linux: Ubuntu, Debian, Mint, Pop!_OS          | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-Linux-x64.deb`                                                                            |
| Linux: Fedora, RHEL, openSUSE                 | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-Linux-x64.rpm`                                                                            |
| Linux: any other distro                       | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-Linux-x64.AppImage`                                                                       |
| Android phone or tablet                       | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-Android.apk`                                                                              |

Not sure which Mac you have? Apple menu → About This Mac: "Chip" means Apple chip, "Processor" means Intel.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum. The `.app.tar.gz` files are the bare macOS apps; most players want the `.dmg`.
